sources.snippet: I recently explored an MLX-optimized build of Qwen3.8-27B for Apple Silicon. What stood out was its multiple quantization options and how they balance performance with memory usage. Since its safety alignment has been removed, it's best viewed as a research tool for AI safety and red-teaming rather than a production-ready assistant.
